name: Leo
bio: I work on agent engineering at Alibaba. I hold a bachelor’s degree from Sichuan University, and I’m building my public work around agent applications and agent infrastructure.
mission: I want to contribute practical tools, reproducible experiments, and clear technical explanations that help make agents more useful and dependable.

focus.name: Agent applications
focus.description: Useful workflows, tool use, and turning an idea into something people can actually use.

focus.name: Agent infrastructure
focus.description: Execution harnesses, state, memory, and the interfaces that make agent behavior easier to inspect and improve.

focus.name: Evaluation & reliability
focus.description: Reproducible tests, failure analysis, and evidence that holds up beyond a single successful demo.

projects.name: Agent Observatory
projects.description: An English research reader for AI agents and agent infrastructure, with arXiv discovery, paper introductions, abstracts, topic filters, and a browser-local reading list.
